Bug_Title: "volatile" variables should not be used with compound operators
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded by using volatile variables with compound operators (++ and!) in methods incrementCount() and toggleBoo(). This can lead to data loss when threads interleave in the steps of the update.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when 'volatile' variables are used with compound operators in multi-threaded scenarios. In this test case, multiple threads are incrementing the 'count' variable, which is defined as 'volatile'. This can lead to data loss or inconsistencies due to the non-atomic nature of the increment operation.
